title: The most expensive watches ever sold at auction
hook: The Most Expensive Watches Ever Sold.
why: LISTICLE, 6-8 slides, one record per slide, highest first. Use only results confirmed on the auction house's own results page (Christie's, Phillips, Sotheby's, Antiquorum) or two trusted outlets; give hammer price with fees stated, sale year and auction house. Candidates to verify (drop any you cannot confirm): Patek Philippe Grandmaster Chime 6300A-010 (Only Watch 2019); Patek Philippe Henry Graves Supercomplication; Paul Newman's own Rolex Daytona 6239; Rolex 'Bao Dai'; Patek Philippe 1518 in steel. Photos only via photo.js (auction lot page with the reference, or free-licence Commons); a record without a usable photo gets an A-number slide instead. Caption lists each result with its source.

A search this round surfaced only snippet-level figures for about 5 watches: Only Watch 2019 Grandmaster Chime 6300A-010 (Christie's Geneva, 9 Nov 2019, CHF 31,000,000); Henry Graves Supercomplication (CHF 23,237,000); Paul Newman Daytona 6239 (Phillips New York, 26 Oct 2017, US$17.75m); Gobbi Milano Heures Universelles 2523 (Christie's Hong Kong, 23 Nov 2019, HKD 70,175,000); Patek 1518 (Phillips Geneva, Nov 2016, US$11m). None was opened on the auction house's own results page, and none has a stated fee status. Snippets are not reads, so nothing was posted. Owner decision needed: (1) Accept a shorter 5-item list (under the 8-item minimum) with the auction house results pages as sources, or (2) approve a different angle, such as a 'Top 5 auction records by house' format, that needs fewer confirmed items. Until one is chosen, this candidate stays held.
